indices.name: DFM General Index

indices.name: Custom

indices.name: DFM General Index (synthetic, market-cap weighted)
indices.source: Synthetic: daily total market cap of 52 DFM stocks (rebased to 100)
indices.note: Proxy for official DFMGI. Daily market-cap-weighted index computed from the 52 DFM stocks' daily close prices and current market caps.
